response.text: Now I have a clear picture. Invoice 285's journal (1452) posts 19774.55 against an INV_AMT of 19756.55, a difference of 18.00 that is not explained by the 9.00 journal imbalances. Invoice 647 is the AP side of the unbalanced journal 2034. Invoice 801 is a credit memo posted with the sign reversed relative to its amount. I'm submitting these findings.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=2034 GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: GL journal 2034 (AP, period 11) is out of balance: DR 7439.39 vs CR 7448.39, difference -9.00. It is the journal for AP invoice 647 (V0023-66438-647, INV_AMT 7448.39), so the debit line is 9.00 short of the invoice amount.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=2386 GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: GL journal 2386 (GL, period 7) is out of balance: DR 3579.03 vs CR 3588.03, difference -9.00 across 3 lines.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."INV_ID", h."INV_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS jr_cr, SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS jr_dr FROM "APINVH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."INV_ID"=285 GROUP BY h."INV_ID", h."INV_AMT", h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."CR_AMT")<>h."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: AP invoice 285 (V0019-22697-285, INV_AMT 19756.55, paid) is recorded in journal 1452 with DR and CR both 19774.55, an 18.00 overstatement versus the invoice amount.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."INV_ID", h."INV_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS jr_dr FROM "APINVH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."INV_ID"=647 GROUP BY h."INV_ID", h."INV_AMT", h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>h."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: AP invoice 647 (INV_AMT 7448.39) is recorded in journal 2034 with credit 7448.39 but debit only 7439.39, so the AP-to-GL tie-out fails on the expense side by 9.00 (same root cause as journal 2034).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."INV_ID", h."VEND_CD", h."INV_NO", h."INV_AMT", h."STAT_CD", h."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" h WHERE h."INV_AMT" < 0
findings.summary: Credit memo APINVH 801 (V0013-67522-1-CM, INV_AMT -6188.59) is stored with a negative amount, contrary to the unsigned-amount convention, yet its journal 2430 posts a positive 6188.59 to AP (2000) as DR and to 5300 as CR. The sign of the stored amount and the sign of the journal posting disagree, so the document's direction cannot be determined from the data. Status is still O (open) with no payment and no void status.
